items.title_cn: 内源性代谢物作为急性胰腺炎的主动驱动因素：机制与靶向治疗进展
items.title_en: Endogenous metabolites as active drivers of acute pancreatitis: Mechanisms and advances in targeted therapy
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种常见的急腹症，由胰腺腺泡细胞损伤启动。约20%的患者进展为伴有多器官功能障碍的重症，病死率居高不下。然而，目前临床管理仍以支持性液体复苏、营养支持和并发症处理为主，尚无针对其关键致病机制的特定药物获批。代谢组学研究的进展揭示了多条代谢通路的紊乱，包括脂质介质、胆汁酸、短链脂肪酸、氨基酸和色氨酸代谢物等。这些紊乱不仅是AP的被动伴随现象，更是损伤启动、炎症放大和免疫失调的积极参与者。因此，针对代谢网络失衡的干预措施已成为新的治疗方向。本综述基于代谢物的来源将其分为三类：宿主酶系统直接产生的内源性代谢物（脂质、嘌呤、色氨酸、氨基酸及其衍生物、多胺和氧化应激相关代谢物）；微生物群来源的代谢物（短链脂肪酸和吲哚类）；以及依赖宿主-微生物群协作的共代谢物（胆汁酸）。随后，我们系统综述了八条代谢通路在AP中的病理作用及靶向干预策略。从时空角度出发，我们进一步提出两个整合性概念框架——线粒体作为多重打击整合节点，以及肠道作为三种信使的来源。我们还建立了从人体治疗证据到机制外推的四级证据分层体系，并根据病程的时间特征设计了基于分期的联合干预策略。我们的目标是为AP的代谢靶向治疗提供从机制网络到临床转化的全面参考。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a common acute abdominal emergency initiated by pancreatic acinar cell injury.Approximately 20% of patients progress to severe disease with multiple organ dysfunction, and mortality rates remain high.However, current clinical management remains largely supportive fluid resuscitation, nutritional support, and complication management and no specific drug has yet been approved directly targeting its key pathogenic mechanisms.Advances in metabolomics have revealed disruptions in multiple pathways, including lipid mediators, bile acids, short-chain fatty acids, amino acids, and tryptophan metabolites.These disruptions are not merely passive epiphenomena of AP but rather active participants in injury initiation, inflammatory amplification, and immune dysregulation.Consequently, interventions targeting metabolic network imbalance have emerged as a novel therapeutic direction.This narrative review classifies metabolites into three categories based on their origin: Endogenous metabolites directly generated by host enzyme systems (lipids, purines, tryptophan, amino acids and their derivatives, polyamines, and oxidative stress-related metabolites); Microbiota-derived metabolites (short-chain fatty acids and indoles); and co-metabolites that depend on host-microbiota collaboration (bile acids).We then systematically review the pathological roles and targeted intervention strategies of eight metabolic pathways in AP.From a spatiotemporal perspective, we further propose two integrative conceptual frameworks the mitochondrion as a multi-hit integration node and the gut as a source of three messengers.We also establish a four-tier evidence stratification ranging from human therapeutic evidence to mechanistic extrapolation, and design a phase-based combination intervention strategy informed by the temporal features of the disease course.Our aim is to provide a comprehensive reference spanning from mechanistic networks to clinical translation for metabolism-targeted therapy in AP.
items.summary_cn: 该综述系统阐述了急性胰腺炎中内源性代谢物（脂质、胆汁酸、短链脂肪酸、氨基酸、色氨酸代谢物等）作为疾病主动驱动因素的作用机制，并提出了基于代谢网络失衡的靶向治疗策略及分期联合干预方案，与用户聚焦的急性胰腺炎诊治方向高度契合。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎死亡风险预测的代谢-临床XGBoost模型开发与外部验证：一项双队列研究及糖尿病分层混杂控制——TRIPOD+AI合规预测模型研究
items.title_en: Development and external validation of a metabolic-clinical XGBoost model for mortality prediction in acute pancreatitis: a dual-cohort study with DM-stratified confounding control A TRIPOD+AI-compliant prediction model study
items.summary_cn: 该研究开发并外部验证了一个基于代谢和临床指标的XGBoost模型用于急性胰腺炎死亡风险预测，并采用糖尿病分层控制混杂因素，符合TRIPOD+AI规范。

items.title_cn: 慢性胰腺炎有创评估中发现的隐匿性胰腺导管腺癌：一项回顾性研究
items.title_en: Occult pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma in patients undergoing invasive evaluation for chronic pancreatitis: A retrospective study
items.abstract_cn:
背景
慢性胰腺炎（CP）是胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的公认危险因素；然而，这两种疾病在临床和影像学表现上的重叠使得早期鉴别尤为困难。
目的
识别接受有创诊断或外科手术的CP患者中隐匿性PDAC的独立危险因素。
方法
我们对2013年至2023年间接受有创诊断或外科手术的359例CP患者进行了回顾性队列研究。根据手术标本或细针穿刺活检获得的组织病理学结果对患者进行分类。分析了临床特征、影像学表现和实验室参数。采用最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）回归进行变量筛选，随后进行多因素logistic回归以识别与PDAC相关的独立危险因素。
结果
在359例CP患者中，33例（9.20%）经组织病理学诊断为PDAC。LASSO回归筛选出胰腺肿块、主胰管结石、血尿素氮、血清离子钙、糖类抗原19-9（CA19-9）和癌胚抗原（CEA）作为候选因素。多因素logistic分析显示，血清离子钙升高[比值比（OR）= 2.67，95%置信区间（95%CI）：1.23-6.88，P = 0.015]、CA19-9升高（OR = 2.83，95%CI：1.79-5.26，P < 0.001）和CEA升高（OR = 1.52，95%CI：1.05-2.17，P = 0.026）与PDAC的存在独立相关。
结论
在需要接受有创操作的CP患者中，9.20%经组织病理学诊断为PDAC。血清离子钙、CA19-9和CEA水平升高被确定为独立危险因素。
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUNDChronic pancreatitis (CP) is a well-established risk factor for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC); however, the overlapping clinical and imaging features of the two conditions make early differentiation particularly challenging. AIMTo identify independent risk factors for occult PDAC in patients with CP undergoing invasive diagnostic or surgical procedures. METHODSWe conducted a retrospective cohort study of 359 patients with CP who underwent invasive diagnostic or surgical procedures between 2013 and 2023.Patients were classified according to histopathological findings obtained from surgical specimens or fine-needle biopsy.Clinical characteristics, radiological findings, and laboratory parameters were analyzed.Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression was applied for variable selection, followed by multivariable logistic regression to identify independent risk factors associated with PDAC. RESULTSAmong the 359 patients with CP, 33 (9.20%) were histopathologically diagnosed with PDAC.LASSO regression identified pancreatic mass, main pancreatic duct stones, blood urea nitrogen, serum ionized calcium, carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9), and carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) as candidate factors.Multivariable logistic analysis demonstrated that elevated serum ionized calcium [odds ratio (OR) = 2.67, 95% confidence interval (95%CI): 1.23-6.88,P = 0.015], CA19-9 (OR = 2.83, 95%CI: 1.79-5.26,P < 0.001), and CEA (OR = 1.52, 95%CI: 1.05-2.17,P = 0.026) were independently associated with the presence of PDAC. / 30 CONCLUSIONAmong patients with CP requiring invasive procedures, 9.20% were histopathologically diagnosed with PDAC.Elevated serum ionized calcium, CA19-9, and CEA levels were identified as independent risk factors.
items.summary_cn: 在接受有创检查或手术的慢性胰腺炎患者中，9.20%被组织病理学诊断为胰腺导管腺癌；血清离子钙、CA19-9和CEA升高是隐匿性胰腺癌的独立危险因素。

items.title_cn: 奥泽沙星（Tryngolza）治疗重度高甘油三酯血症。
items.abstract_cn: FDA已批准olezarsen（Tryngolza – Ionis），这是一种皮下注射的靶向载脂蛋白C-III（apoC-III）的反义寡核苷酸，用于降低严重高甘油三酯血症成人患者的甘油三酯水平及急性胰腺炎风险。此前，olezarsen和靶向apoC-III的小干扰RNA plozasiran（Redemplo）已被批准用于降低家族性乳糜微粒血症综合征（FCS）成人患者的甘油三酯水平。
items.abstract_en: The FDA has approved olezarsen (Tryngolza – Ionis), a subcutaneously injected apolipoprotein C-III (apoC-III)-directed antisense oligonucleotide, to reduce triglyceride levels and the risk of acute pancreatitis in adults with severe hypertriglyceridemia. Olezarsen and the apoC-III-directed small interfering RNA plozasiran (Redemplo) were approved earlier to reduce triglyceride levels in adults with familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS).
items.journal: The Medical letter on drugs and therapeutics
items.summary_cn: FDA批准olezarsen（一种靶向apoC-III的反义寡核苷酸）用于降低严重高甘油三酯血症成人患者的甘油三酯水平并减少急性胰腺炎风险；该药及plozasiran此前已被批准用于家族性乳糜微粒血症综合征（FCS）患者降低甘油三酯。

items.title_en: Pancreatic Arteriovenous Malformation with Acute Pancreatitis-Induced Aneurysm
items.journal: Journal of Gastrointestinal and Liver Diseases
items.summary_cn: 该论文报道了胰腺动静脉畸形合并急性胰腺炎诱发动脉瘤的病例，与急性胰腺炎的诊治直接相关，但摘要未提供具体治疗或结局信息。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎感染的负担与影响：基于全国住院患者样本的见解
items.title_en: Burden and Impact of Infections in Acute Pancreatitis: Insights from the National Inpatient Sample
items.abstract_cn: 背景与目的：急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种严重程度范围广泛的炎症性疾病。肠道屏障破坏及肠道菌群易位增加了感染性并发症的风险。本研究评估感染对住院AP患者院内结局的影响。方法：从全国住院患者样本（NIS）数据库（2016–2022年）中，使用ICD-10编码识别住院成人AP患者。排除人口统计学或死亡数据缺失的患者，其余患者按感染类型进行分层。分析人口统计学特征、AP病因、合并症及临床结局。主要结局为按感染类型划分的院内死亡率。次要结局包括脓毒症、休克、急性肾损伤（AKI）、重症监护病房（ICU）入住、深静脉血栓（DVT）、肺栓塞（PE）及门静脉血栓（PVT）。结果：在2,467,233例AP患者中，392,255例（15.9%）发生感染性并发症。尿路感染（UTI）最常见（51%），其次为肺炎（29.7%）、胆管炎（14.5%）、艰难梭菌感染（CDI）（7.9%）、蜂窝织炎（5.6%）和自发性细菌性腹膜炎（SBP）（1.9%）。SBP的死亡率最高（21.1%），其次为肺炎（12.8%），而UTI（4.5%）、胆管炎（5.2%）、CDI（6.9%）和蜂窝织炎（5.9%）的死亡率较低。在校正混杂因素后，合并感染的AP患者院内死亡率更高（6.7% vs 1.6%，p < 0.001）。结论：感染性并发症，尤其是SBP和肺炎，与AP患者显著更差的院内结局相关，凸显了早期识别和管理的重要性。
items.abstract_en: Background and Aims: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is an inflammatory disease with a wide range of severity. Disruption of the intestinal barrier and translocation of gut flora increase the risk of infectious complications. Our study evaluates the impact of infections on in-hospital outcomes among admitted AP patients. Methods: Hospitalized adult AP patients were identified from the National Inpatient Sample (NIS) database (2016–2022) using ICD-10 codes. Patients with missing demographic or mortality data were excluded, and those remaining were stratified by infection type. Demographics, AP etiology, comorbidities, and clinical outcomes were analyzed. The primary outcome was in-hospital mortality by infection type. Secondary outcomes included sepsis, shock, acute kidney injury (AKI), intensive care unit (ICU) admission, deep vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and portal vein thrombosis (PVT). Results: Among 2,467,233 patients with AP, 392,255 (15.9%) developed infectious complications. Urinary tract infections (UTIs) were most common (51%), followed by pneumonia (29.7%), cholangitis (14.5%), Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) (7.9%), cellulitis (5.6%), and spontaneous bacterial peritonitis (SBP) (1.9%). SBP had the highest mortality (21.1%), followed by pneumonia (12.8%), whereas mortality was lower with UTI (4.5%), cholangitis (5.2%), CDI (6.9%), and cellulitis (5.9%). AP patients with infections had higher in-hospital mortality after adjusting for confounding factors (6.7% vs 1.6%, p < 0.001). Conclusions: Infectious complications, particularly SBP and pneumonia, were associated with significantly worse in-hospital outcomes in patients with AP, highlighting the importance of early recognition and management.
items.journal: Journal of Gastrointestinal and Liver Diseases
items.summary_cn: 该研究基于美国全国住院样本数据库，发现急性胰腺炎患者中感染并发症（尤其是自发性细菌性腹膜炎和肺炎）与显著更高的住院死亡率及更差的临床结局相关，强调了早期识别和处理感染的重要性。

items.title_cn: C反应蛋白血浆分离：急性坏死性胰腺炎的新型治疗方法
items.title_en: C-reactive Protein Apheresis: A Novel Treatment Approach in Acute Necrotising Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 急性坏死性胰腺炎是一种与高发病率和死亡率相关的严重疾病。在大多数情况下，支持性治疗是唯一可用的治疗选择。本文报告一例29岁男性患者，因高甘油三酯血症引发重症急性坏死性胰腺炎，继而发展为急性呼吸窘迫综合征和多器官功能衰竭。我们在最佳支持性治疗（包括有创通气、俯卧位通气、使用CytoSorb™颗粒滤器的连续性静脉-静脉血液透析、抗生素、血管升压药及液体复苏）基础上，加用了标签外使用的C反应蛋白吸附治疗，以针对无菌性炎症反应。经过18天重症监护治疗和11天常规护理治疗后，患者成功存活出院。
items.abstract_en: Acute necrotizing pancreatitis is a severe condition associating with high morbidity and mortality. In most cases, supportive therapy is the only available therapeutic option. Herein, we report a case of a 29-year-old male who presented with severe acute necrotizing pancreatitis caused by hypertriglyceridemia, who consequently developed acute respiratory distress syndrome and multi-organ failure. We used an off-label C-reactive protein apheresis to target the sterile inflammatory reactions additional to optimal supportive therapy with invasive ventilation, prone positioning, continuous veno-venous hemodialysis using a CytoSorb™ particle filter, antibiotics, vasopressors, and fluids. After 18 days of intensive care treatment and 11 days of normal care treatment, the patient could be discharged alive.
items.journal: Journal of Gastrointestinal and Liver Diseases
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一种针对重症急性坏死性胰腺炎的辅助治疗（C反应蛋白吸附），在标准支持治疗基础上用于控制无菌性炎症反应，患者最终存活出院。

items.title_cn: 丙泊酚与克利维地平持续输注联合使用的安全性：多中心回顾性分析
items.title_en: Safety of Coadministration of Continuous Infusions of Propofol and Clevidipine: A Multi‐Site Retrospective Analysis
items.abstract_cn: 引言：重症监护病房的患者常接受丙泊酚镇静和氯维地平控制高血压。两种药物均以脂肪乳剂为制剂，联合使用时可能增加高甘油三酯血症和急性胰腺炎的风险。本研究旨在确定丙泊酚与氯维地平同时给药时高甘油三酯血症和急性胰腺炎的发生率，并识别高甘油三酯血症的患者危险因素。方法：这是一项多中心回顾性研究，纳入同时接受丙泊酚和氯维地平输注≥6小时的成年患者（≥18岁）。主要结局为甘油三酯水平超过400 mg/dL的发生频率及急性胰腺炎的发生情况。次要结局为在丙泊酚和氯维地平同时输注期间直至两种输注均停止时，与高甘油三酯血症相关的危险因素。采用单变量和多变量逻辑回归分析评估接受丙泊酚和氯维地平同时输注患者发生高甘油三酯血症的危险因素。结果：共纳入1，226例患者，输注重叠的中位持续时间为12.4 [四分位距（IQR）8.3，22.7]小时。队列平均年龄为59.6 [标准差（SD）14.9]岁，其中59.4%为男性。假设未检测甘油三酯水平的患者未发生高甘油三酯血症，则在开始丙泊酚和氯维地平输注后，整个队列中高甘油三酯血症的发生率为7.7% [95%置信区间（CI）6.3%至9.3%]。26例患者（2.1%）在开始脂肪乳输注后被诊断为胰腺炎，其中12例可能为输注相关，1例很可能为输注相关。根据Naranjo量表评估，所有13例胰腺炎病例均可能与丙泊酚或氯维地平输注相关。基于可获得甘油三酯水平患者的多元逻辑回归分析，高甘油三酯血症的危险因素包括过去5年内的胰腺炎病史[校正比值比（aOR）2.77，95% CI，1.23至6.23]和他汀类药物使用（aOR 1.94，95% CI，1.13至3.34）。结论：在我们的同时接受丙泊酚和氯维地平输注的患者队列中，高甘油三酯血症和急性胰腺炎的发生率较低。需要进一步的比较研究来评估在丙泊酚基础上加用氯维地平所致胰腺炎的风险。
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Patients often receive propofol for sedation and clevidipine for hypertension in the intensive care unit. Both agents are formulated as a lipid emulsion, which may increase the risk of hypertriglyceridemia and acute pancreatitis with their coadministration. We aimed to determine the incidence of hypertriglyceridemia and acute pancreatitis with concurrent administration of propofol and clevidipine and identify patient risk factors for hypertriglyceridemia. METHODS: This was a multicenter retrospective study of adult patients (≥ 18 years old) receiving concurrent propofol and clevidipine infusions for ≥ 6 h. The primary outcome was the frequency of triglyceride levels greater than 400 mg/dL and acute pancreatitis. The secondary outcome was risk factors associated with hypertriglyceridemia during concurrent propofol and clevidipine infusions until both infusions had been discontinued. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were used to assess risk factors of hypertriglyceridemia in patients receiving concurrent propofol and clevidipine infusions. RESULTS: Across 1,226 patients, the median duration of infusion overlap was 12.4 [interquartile range (IQR) 8.3, 22.7] hours. The mean age of the cohort was 59.6 [standard deviation (SD) 14.9] years, and 59.4% were male. Assuming those without a triglyceride level drawn did not have hypertriglyceridemia, hypertriglyceridemia after initiation of propofol and clevidipine infusion was found in 7.7% [95% confidence interval (CI) 6.3% to 9.3%] of the entire cohort. Twenty-six patients (2.1%) had a diagnosis of pancreatitis after initiation of lipid infusions, of which 12 cases were possibly infusion-related, and one case was likely infusion-related. After calculating the Naranjo Scale, all 13 cases of pancreatitis were possibly related to propofol or clevidipine infusions. Based on a multivariable logistic regression of those with a triglyceride level available, risk factors for hypertriglyceridemia included pancreatitis within the past 5 years [adjusted odds ratio (aOR) 2.77, 95% CI, 1.23 to 6.23] and statin use (aOR 1.94, 95% CI, 1.13 to 3.34). CONCLUSIONS: In our cohort of patients receiving concurrent propofol and clevidipine, the frequency of hypertriglyceridemia and acute pancreatitis was low. Further comparative studies are warranted to assess the risk of pancreatitis with the addition of clevidipine to propofol.
items.journal: Pharmacotherapy The Journal of Human Pharmacology and Drug Therapy
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现，在同时接受丙泊酚和氯维地平输注的患者中，高甘油三酯血症和急性胰腺炎的发生率较低；过去5年内有胰腺炎病史和他汀类药物使用是高甘油三酯血症的风险因素。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
